Marissa / Grace — summary of what I can provide and proposed timeline: 

- SOC 2: We completed a Type II audit covering March 2026–August 2026. Redacted PDF available that omits client-specific identifiers. Attached: SOC2-Summary.pdf (redacted overview) and control-matrix excerpt. Full report will require an NDA/redaction request; procurement usually accepts redacted summary + control matrix.

- HIPAA & BA: Redwood supports processing ePHI in Private deployments; hosted option is possible with contractual safeguards (BAA + specific routing). I’ll draft the standard BAA language we use and flag any language MedNex legal may want to adjust.

- Incident response / breach notification timeline (short):
  • Time to detect (median): 2–6 hours for high-severity detections (our ops pipeline + alerts)
  • Internal escalation: 1 hour to on-call security lead after triage
  • Customer notification: preliminary notification within 24–72 hours depending on triage and scope; formal notification and remediation plan within 7 business days in most cases.

- Evidence we can share: system-level alert logs (redacted), IR playbook excerpt, sample notification template, and timeline matrix. Some raw logs require a legal/data-access request.

Attachments I’ll include in the response to MedNex: 
  - SOC2-Summary.pdf (pdf, 680KB)
  - BCP-DR-Overview.docx (docx, 120KB)
